data.name: Galaxy Card Game
data.detailed_description:
Sci-Fi Setting & World Building

In a distant galaxy, major factions wage fierce wars for stellar dominance. As fleet commanders, players command various combat units and strategize across interstellar battlefields.

All Cards Free Simulator

  • All cards are fully unlocked, no gacha or payment required - pure competitive experience.

  • Focus on strategic combat where skill determines victory.

  • Build any deck freely and jump into battle immediately.

Core Mechanics That Revolutionize Traditional Card Games

  • Supply System: Each unit deployment consumes precious supplies, balancing risk and reward in resource management, breaking through traditional cost limitations.

  • Health System: Units lose health in combat and are destroyed at zero, capable of participating in multiple battles, eliminating one-shot kill mechanics.

  • Redefined Combat Damage: Unit battles don't harm commanders; only direct attacks reduce influence, creating more dynamic breakthrough and interception gameplay.

  • Special Deployment System: Unlimited deployment mechanism - as long as supplies last, continuously expand your fleet to create overwhelming advantages or surprise tactics.

Strategic Depth

  • Turn Phases: Acquire combat resources, activate tactical preparations, deploy units, place facilities, use support cards, command space fleet battles, post-battle adjustments and redeployment, end turn processing.

Strategic Elements

  • Resource Management: Make crucial choices between survival and expansion - every supply point matters.

  • Unit Configuration: Multiple unit categories including Human, Mammalian, Arthropod, each with unique tactical characteristics.

  • Trait Combinations: Legion and Fleet trait systems that create powerful synergies.

  • Tactical Timing: Master optimal moments to play support and tactical cards, controlling the battlefield tempo.

  • Unit Types: Basic units, large units, support facilities, and more - build diverse tactical systems.

Game Features

  • Complete Battle System: 2-player and 4-player modes with online, LAN support, and spectating.

  • Deck Management: Intuitive card collection manager, powerful deck builder, search and filter functions, import/export capabilities.

  • Interface & Experience: Modern UI design, full Chinese localization, sound effects and visual support.

Join the galactic battlefield now and experience unprecedented strategic card gameplay! All cards free, fair competition - your tactics decide everything!

Note: This game is adapted from an open-source project. Currently in early access with fully playable core mechanics. Full version will continuously add more cards, modes, and features - stay tuned!

Unique supply mechanics break traditional cost limitations - every deployment is a choice between survival and expansion. All cards free, skill determines victory.
